syllabus_topics: Basic topological notions in R^n, sequences
Extrema and saddle points of scalar fields
Weierstrass Theorem, Taylor's formula, Hessian matrix, Lagrange multipliers
Inverse function and implicit function theorems
Applications of inverse and implicit function theorems
Fundamental Theorem of Calculus for line integrals and applications
Vector fields as gradients of scalar fields
assessment_rules: In the normal period, the evaluation consists of two MAP45 exams, each weighing 30%, and a 1-hour final exam weighing 40%. In the resit period, there will be a 2-hour resit exam worth 100% of the final grade. Alternatively, on the resit exam date, students can retake one of the MAP45s or the first exam, with the new grade replacing the original for normal period calculation. Grades above 17 must be defended in an oral examination.
